verdict.rationale: Apple's own MacBook Pro spec page claims up to 24 hours of video streaming, which is first-party all-day-battery evidence for an M5 machine. Apple also says M5 ships in the iPad Pro, though nothing in the pack describes that design as fanless or thin. The battery figure is a vendor claim only, and nothing documents quiet, thin or fanless designs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on battery-life testing, documented fanless or thin/quiet designs, power-draw or efficiency data for the chip itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, this chip powers thin, quiet, all-day-battery machines — shipping in fanless or low-power designs with credible battery-life evidence

citations.quote: the new 14-inch MacBook Pro and iPad Pro benefit from dramatically accelerated processing for AI-driven workflows
